scope: Structured worker admission and VM-local task/provider state, attemptAll cleanup registration, project payload/check accounting, parser allocation repair, and three suite scheduling transitions. disposition.landingProof: Git ancestry of tested b63d986d61d6e14e5816c500ef9aa738f4d56907; the evidence commit changes no tested production bytes.

behavior.taskState: Task scope/child state and suspension/worker provider state resolve private backing on the current VM global table. Initializers are capture-free; Lua retains module-local behavior. Existing whole-VM checkpoint graph rules remain in force.
behavior.structuredWorkers: A structured fork transfers its owned graph immediately and queues prepared work when 64 structured workers are running in that interpreter. Actual first dispatch marks started. Oldest pending work is admitted after progress drains; queued cancellation does not load or execute its graph. Generic Worker::spawn and supervision Game remain eager.
behavior.persistence: Unstarted prepared workers use a bounded private restore path with channel-only resource preflight, host-pool refusal before resource restoration and TLS restoration on success/error. Started and legacy workers retain existing restore semantics. No Task/Interp/native ABI or checkpoint format change.
behavior.admission: Structured arguments reject foreign metatables while retaining exact registered nominal/resource/native-view codecs, moved-array ownership, cycles and aliases. Generic graph persistence remains unchanged.
behavior.workerFailures: Structured-worker origin prevents nested structured workers. Retained direct-root and parking-cleanup failures carry worker trace information; parent rendering is cached without mutating the raw core Task.error or cancellation identity. Native-callback subsidiary-frame fidelity remains a separately recorded positions-lane gap; no universal stack-fidelity claim.
behavior.attemptAll: VM call lowering publishes checker-resolved cleanup callbacks before evaluating attemptAll values, including statement, local initializer and return contexts. Existing declaration registration order and lexical captures are preserved.
behavior.project: Packaging keeps source when no bytecode dumper is available and preserves dumper flags/errors. Parallel check-only cache results increment checkedModules without counting nonexistent generated code. Existing cache/retry and diagnostic replay semantics remain.
behavior.parser: The image parser reuses one token vector and constructs five existing errors lazily. Its isolated fixed performance result is recorded separately; combined correctness does not create a second performance result.

native.interpreterOnly: --no-default-features all-targets check passed; this is a compile check, not an interpreter test-count claim
